narrative.overview: Clean, purposeful fitness platform designed for clarity and progress tracking. The design prioritizes task focus—whether an athlete is checking today's workout or a coach is reviewing performance—with intuitive navigation and minimal cognitive load.
keyCharacteristics: Clean, minimal aesthetic with breathing space
Strategic color usage (blue for actions, neutrals for content)
Clear typography hierarchy with smart use of weight and size

rules.name: The Clarity Rule
rules.body: Every element communicates status or action. No decorative elements; visual weight matches information hierarchy.

rules.name: The Breathing Space Rule
rules.body: Consistent spacing (8px unit) prevents cognitive overload. Cards and sections have generous padding.

dos: Do use blue primary color sparingly for key actions and navigation
Do maintain ample whitespace for breathing room and clarity
Do ensure 44×44px minimum touch targets on mobile
Do use semantic colors (green for success, red for error, amber for caution)
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for any transitions or animations
donts: Don't overuse accent color; keep it reserved for interactive elements
Don't place text on photographic backgrounds without contrast verification
Don't create horizontal scroll on mobile; keep single-column layout
Don't use color alone to communicate status; pair with icons and text
